Our story

Big moments shouldn’t depend on how many parents are in the house.

Moments & Milestones started in 2025 with one simple idea: single parent families deserve to be supported, celebrated, and empowered to thrive.

A letter from our founder

Welcome to Moments and Milestones.

To every single parent visiting this page: I want you to know right now that you are seen, you are valued, and you do not have to do this alone.

As a single mom to two beautiful twin girls, I know firsthand what it means to carry the weight of a household on your own. I know the unique joys of solo parenting, but I also know the deep exhaustion, the financial stress, and the quiet moments of wondering how you are going to make it all work.

I founded this organization because I realized that while single parents possess unmatched resilience, we shouldn't have to rely on resilience alone. We deserve a community that wraps around us to provide real relief, joy, and connection.

Our mission at Moments and Milestones is to build that village. We step into the gap for solo parents through two primary pillars:

  • Community Events: We host regular gatherings designed to bring single-parent families together, helping you build lasting friendships and proving to your kids that they belong to a large, supportive community.
  • Our Christmas Gift Program: We believe every child deserves holiday magic, and no parent should have to choose between keeping the lights on and placing presents under the tree. Our seasonal program steps in to help purchase Christmas gifts, easing the financial pressure of the holidays.

To the parents looking for support: Our doors and our hearts are open to you. Please join us at our .

To our community donors and volunteers: Thank you for standing with us. Your generosity directly funds these events and puts smiles on children's faces on Christmas morning.

Together, we are ensuring that no single parent walks this road alone.

Warmly,

Charlee Hansen

Founder, Moments and Milestones

For families

Need a hand? You’re in the right place.

If you’re a single parent anywhere in Utah, reaching out is the hardest part. We made the rest easy. No long applications and no judgment.

What we can help with

Resources for the real stuff

Every family is different, so we start by listening. Here's what we can connect you with. Looking for help right now?

Support and guidance when you're working toward stable housing, from finding options to help with a deposit.

Essentials

Someone to talk to

Our weekly support group and a team that will actually call you back.

EVERYFriday

Single Parent Support Group

Every Friday at 8:30 PM we hop on Google Meet to talk, vent, swap resources, and make friends who understand. Join from your couch after the kids are in bed. Come once or come every week.

How it works

Three simple steps

Everything you share stays with our small team.

  1. Say hi

    Fill out the short form below and tell us a little about your family and what would help most right now.

  2. Let's chat

    Someone from our team gives you a call to listen and figure out the best fit together.

  3. We connect you

    Resources, event invites, the Friday support group, or help from our partners.

Questions parents ask

Good to know

Who can reach out?

Any single parent family in Utah. Most of our events and support happen along the Wasatch Front.

Does it cost anything?

No. Our events, the support group, and our help are free for the families we serve.

Will my information be private?

Yes. What you share stays with our small team and is only used to help your family.

Where does the support group meet?

Online over Google Meet, every Friday at 8:30 PM. No need to find a sitter, just join from home.

Resources

Utah resources for single parents

Help with food, housing, health care, and hard days, all in one place. Save this page and come back anytime.

Resource photo
In crisis or having a really hard day?

Call or text 988 anytime, day or night. You can also call the Salt Lake crisis line at 801-587-1055. If you are in danger, call 911.

Mental health + crisis support

  • Mobile Crisis Outreach + Crisis Line

    24/7 crisis support for anyone in Salt Lake County.

    801-587-1055
  • 211 Utah

    Connects you to housing, food, or counseling resources, 24/7. Dial 211.

    211utah.org ↗211
  • NAMI Utah

    Free mental health classes and peer support groups.

    namiut.org ↗
  • Family Support Center · Crisis Nursery

    Safe, free childcare when you are in a crisis or overwhelmed.

    familysupportcenter.org ↗385-231-1209

Drug + alcohol recovery

  • Volunteers of America Utah

    Treatment, recovery, and support services.

    voaut.org ↗801-363-9400
  • All In Solutions

    Addiction treatment and recovery support.

    allinsolutions.com ↗855-635-2029

Food + nutrition

  • SNAP (food stamps)

    Monthly help buying groceries.

    jobs.utah.gov/foodstamps ↗800-331-4341
  • Utah WIC

    Food, nutrition help, and support for moms, babies, and kids under 5.

    fns.usda.gov/wic ↗801-538-6960
  • Utah Food Bank

    Find a food pantry or mobile food pantry near you.

    utahfoodbank.org ↗
  • School Breakfast Program

    Free or reduced-price breakfast at school.

    fns.usda.gov/sbp ↗801-538-7680
  • Special Milk Program

    Milk for kids at school and child care.

    fns.usda.gov/smp ↗801-538-7680
  • Summer Food Service

    Free summer meals for kids when school is out.

    fns.usda.gov/sfsp ↗

Health insurance

  • Utah Medicaid

    Health coverage for families who qualify.

    medicaid.utah.gov ↗800-662-9651
  • CHIP

    Kids health insurance: checkups, dental, and prescriptions.

    medicaid.gov/chip ↗1-877-543-7669
  • Medicaid Eligibility Help

    Help figuring out if you qualify.

    medicaidplanningassistance.org ↗

Housing + utilities

  • Section 8 Housing Vouchers (HUD)

    Help paying rent for families who qualify.

    hud.gov ↗800-955-2232
  • HEAT Program

    Help paying winter heating and power bills.

    utahca.org/heat-program ↗866-205-4357
  • The Road Home

    Emergency shelter and housing support.

    theroadhome.org ↗
  • Making Home Affordable

    Help for homeowners and mortgage relief.

    makinghomeaffordable.gov ↗888-995-4673

Not sure where to start? Reach out and we’ll help you figure out the next step.

We share these to help, and we aren’t affiliated with these organizations. Details can change, so check with each one directly. Know a great resource we should add? Let us know!

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us

Last updated October 2026

Moments and Milestones is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Utah (EIN 39-2582337). This page explains what information we collect through supportsingleparents.com and how we use it.

What we collect

We only collect what you choose to share with us, like your name, email, phone number, and the details you write in our forms. This includes our contact form, newsletter signup, Trunk or Treat registration, and Christmas family nominations. Those forms are run through Google Forms.

How we use it

  • To reply to you and connect your family with support or resources
  • To plan and run our events
  • To send our newsletter, only if you signed up for it
  • To thank donors, sponsors, and volunteers

What we never do

We never sell, rent, or trade your information. Details about families we serve stay with our small team and are only used to help that family. Nominations are kept confidential.

Donations

Donations are handled by Every.org and Venmo. We don't see or store your card or bank details. Their own privacy policies apply when you give through them.

Other websites

Our site links to Google Forms, Every.org, Venmo, GolfStatus, Google Meet, Facebook, Instagram, and other helpful resources. We're not responsible for how those sites handle your information.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe from our newsletter anytime, or ask us to update or delete your information. Just email us at momentsandmilestones2025@gmail.com.

Kids

Our site is meant for parents and adults. We don't knowingly collect information directly from children. When a parent shares details about their kids, like ages or clothing sizes for the Christmas program, we use it only to help that family.

Questions

Email momentsandmilestones2025@gmail.com and we'll be happy to help.

Terms of Use

The simple version

Last updated October 2026

About this site

This website shares information about Moments and Milestones, our events, and ways to get involved. We do our best to keep it accurate, but event details, resources, and programs can change.

Resources we list

Our resource list is shared to help, and we aren't affiliated with those organizations. Please check with each one directly. Nothing on this site is professional, legal, medical, or financial advice. In a crisis, call or text 988, or call 911 in an emergency.

Support and nominations

Reaching out or submitting a nomination doesn't guarantee assistance. We help as many families as our resources allow.

Donations

Moments and Milestones is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 39-2582337. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Gifts made through Every.org or Venmo follow their terms.

Events

Parents and guardians are responsible for supervising their children at our events. By attending, you agree to follow event guidelines and treat everyone with kindness.

Our content

Our name, logo, photos, and writing belong to Moments and Milestones. Please ask before using them.
